title: Realtime failure / slow / reconnect / revocation invariants at component level

workload.ports: injected failing / slow ports, fake timers (FE); mocked trusted adapter, no PG (server)

stop_conditions: a vitest run with a non-zero exit is reported per repetition
an unstable test (pass/fail across repetitions) is listed

binary_criteria.criterion: <= 1 read/s/screen: a delta storm or a steady 100/s stream folds into bounded re-reads
<= 3 auto-resync per 60 s then unavailable; a gap earns one resnapshot, a second gap closes the channel
no infinite reconnect: a dying transport / failing bootstrap is final, no retry loop
a hidden tab triggers no re-read (one on becoming visible)
0 restricted frame after a revocation: purge queued frames, deny before read, ignore late completion
stale / replayed / other-filter cursor is rejected before any read
queues, clients and in-flight reads are bounded; stop drains without a leak

slowest_tests_ms.name: V2 screens · mounting and unmounting leave nothing registered flag-on overview: V2 root mounts, unmount returns document/window listeners and intervals to the baseline
L2 · backlog a terminal frame behind a flood of 100,000 notices is applied at once
L2 · frame rate a million heartbeats start no read and leave the state constant-size
V2 screens · mounting and unmounting leave nothing registered flag-off: the same routes serve V1 (no V2 root, no V2 chrome) and a second pass adds nothing
L2 · frame rate an hour of a notice every 10 ms: at most one read start per window, never two in flight
L2 · backlog a tab hidden for an hour under a notice every 10 ms starts no read, and pays exactly one on return
V2 screens · mounting and unmounting leave nothing registered flipping the list between V2 and V1 mounts (what two builds amount to) accumulates no listener or interval
state is bounded the serialised state does not grow with the number of frames

record_only.revocation_to_stream_close_latency: NOT_MEASURED: needs a real stream; no threshold exists (NO BASIS, needs Edge/Bobby)

cleanup.note: vitest workers exit with the run

limitations: Component level: injected ports and fake timers, no real EventSource, no source, no Core009.
Transport drop, slow consumer, epoch rebuild, READ-only / STREAM-only revoke on a real stream, 1-hour hidden tab are not run (window M-3c).
Criteria matching is by test-name pattern: a criterion with zero matching tests would show matching_tests=0 and passed_all_reps=false.
Durations are host-load dependent; the invariants are not.
